chapterMapWidth.note: Policy card (.policy-parent) on the chapter Models map. Before: min(28em, 42cqw) = 364px. After: the two model-head columns (stage minus the lens rail and gap). Map document widths.

ch04Geometry.arms: At min-width 801px the 4.1 card spans the two model-head columns. Its centre is the 4.2/4.3 head midpoint. The lens rail stays to the left of both.

ch05Rail.lead: Reflect the pattern of consumption of future economic benefits

citeChips.note: Teaching tables only. Naked secondary tails replaced with a second full chip. No ranges invented.

ch05Hold: 5.5 is its own rail, Depreciation method, after 5.3 and before 5.4. The lead line stays Reflect the pattern of consumption of future economic benefits. Each method box has a 120×48 chart between the name and the caption. Master Dep beat uses the same rail label and does not use the charts.

ch05Period.note: Desktop (922 and 1280): both cards fly right from their markers, equal width. Lane border-boxes start at the Begins ring centre and the chevron tip (border-box right) ends at the Ceases ring centre. The Ceases card overhangs to the right of its marker and stays inside the content box. Dashed tail and arrowhead run past Ceases under that card. No time label. At max-width 800 (390 and 667) the timeline is vertical: lane top equals the Begins ring centre and lane bottom (point) equals the Ceases ring centre.

rows: Special considerations for land and buildings
ch05LifeRail.definition: Two equal peer boxes with a centred OR, then May be shorter than its economic life.
ch05LifeRail.factors: 2×2 above 800px with an 8px gap; one per row at max-width 800. All four share one height.

stuckRails: No shared border at any width. Inner rails keep the board gap of 0.45rem (7.19px) at 390, 667, 922, and 1280, with full corner radius. Master phase rails Scope through Disclosure use that same row gap from 801px up (6.19px between border boxes at 922 and 1280). Below 801px each phase rail is a full-width header with margin 0.7rem 0 0.4rem. Content boxes keep the 0.45rem row gap.

railJunctions.note: Same-column consecutive inner rails. Gap is the border-box separation. 7.19px is 0.45rem. Content gap is the box beside the upper rail to the box beside the lower rail.

residualToCharge.where: Residual value to 5.7 Charge location. Wide map only: .cap is one column at max-width 800, so those rails are not in the same column at 390 or 667.

reconToRestrictions.where: master disclosure, 7.3 Reconciliation to 7.4 Restrictions, all four widths
reconToRestrictions.mobileHold: 7.3 to 7.4 is +7.19px at 390, 667, 922, and 1280 on master and ch07. Content gap stays 7.19.

railJunctions.otherSameColumn: Same-column inner rails keep 7.19px at every width. Phase rails Scope through Disclosure are 6.19px apart on the wide map. ch01, ch03, and ch04 have no stacked inner rails. At ≤800 the 5.5 and 5.4 bands stay full-width headers.

ch06.spine: Plate 6.0 Derecognition — remove carrying amount. Four rails with a 7.19px gap. Horizontal cost-eq. Case-set 6.5 beside 6.3. Foot see IFRS 15 / IFRS 16 / IAS 2 / IFRS 5. No decision-fork, span-bar, exit-shaft, or fifth rail.
rails: Where carrying amount or proceeds go
ch06.compensation: 6.6 nest under the plate foot, dashed, not an inner-rail and not a third case-cell
ch06.onward: Disclosure text link to ch07 7.0. No pack-flow shaft.

ch07.spine: Disc-band 7.0 Disclosure. Outer rail Required for each class nests 7.1 / 7.2 / 7.3. Outer rail Also required nests 7.4, Depreciation and accumulated depreciation, and Changes in estimates. Condition rails 7.5 / 7.6 / 7.7 Encouraged muted. Foot see IAS 36 and IAS 23. No model-entry, span-bar, peers-4, side-facets, limb-run, or tip-line 7.8.
ch07.arrows: No shafts. Probe 0/0. Master arrow counts unchanged (15/15/22/22).
ch07.upstream: From Derecognition text link. No pack-flow shaft.
